name: Slow-Cooker White Chicken Chili

ingredients.name: great Northern beans, drained and rinsed, divided
finely chopped cilantro tender stems and leaves, plus more leaves for garnish

instructions.primary_message: In a 6-quart or larger slow cooker, whisk together chicken stock or broth, sazón, salt, cumin, coriander, oregano, onion powder, and garlic powder until combined.
Stir in 2 cans of beans and mild and hot diced green chiles. Nestle chicken thighs, skin side up, into bean mixture in an even layer.
Cover and cook on LOW until chicken is very tender and a thermometer inserted into the thickest portion of chicken registers at least 175°F and up to 195°F, about 5 hours.
Use tongs to transfer chicken to a cutting board; let stand until cool enough to handle, about 10 minutes. Remove and discard skin and bones. Shred meat using 2 forks.

In slow cooker, use a large fork or potato masher to mash about half of the beans until smooth. Return shredded chicken and add remaining 1 can of beans to slow cooker. Stir in cilantro, lime juice, and fish sauce.
Ladle chili evenly into serving bowls.. Serve with shredded cheese, sour cream, tortilla chips, pickled red onions, cilantro leaves, and lime wedges, if desired.

schema_metadata.keywords: Slow-Cooker White Chicken Chili, White Chicken Chili recipe

description: This slow-cooker white chicken chili is rich, savory, and layered with flavor—all without searing or stovetop prep.
notes:
Optional or for serving: 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice from 1 medium lime, plus lime wedges for serving

Optional substitutions: homemade chicken stock → store-bought low-sodium chicken broth; Shredded sharp white cheddar → Monterey Jack cheese

Notes: If using store-bought broth, you can use any low-sodium chicken broth, including bone broths such as Kettle & Fire's reduced-sodium chicken bone broth.Using sazón sin achiote—sazón without annato—keeps the chili's color pale, though if you only have sazón with achiote on hand, it will work fine—your chili will just have a slight red cast. Goya is one widely available brand.

Make-ahead and storage: Leftovers can be refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 4 days or frozen for up to 3 months.
